papers.title: Bayesian Kernel and Mutual $k$-Nearest Neighbor Regression
papers.abstract: We propose Bayesian extensions of two nonparametric regression methods which are kernel and mutual $k$-nearest neighbor regression methods. Derived based on Gaussian process models for regression, the extensions provide distributions for target value estimates and the framework to select the hyperparameters. It is shown that both the proposed methods asymptotically converge to kernel and mutual $k$-nearest neighbor regression methods, respectively. The simulation results show that the proposed methods can select proper hyperparameters and are better than or comparable to the former methods for an artificial data set and a real world data set.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了贝叶斯KNN回归方法，但其方法论层面与FEA替代建模或生物力学优化无直接关联，仅提供不确定性量化这一可迁移特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive finite element simulations, constrained optimization, or implant/biomechanics design; it only proposes a Bayesian regression method without FEA context or constraint handling.

summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程的贝叶斯扩展，包括核和互k近邻回归
summary_zh.result: 提出方法渐近收敛于原始方法，超参数选择合理
summary_zh.validation: 人工与真实数据集上的数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To enhance k-nearest neighbor regression with probabilistic predictions and principled hyperparameter selection.
summary_en.method: Bayesian extensions of kernel and mutual k-nearest neighbor regression derived from Gaussian process models.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods asymptotically recover the original methods and yield competitive or superior performance on synthetic and real datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets compare predictive accuracy and hyperparameter selection.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the processability of Al7075 alloy during selective laser melting by compositional modification.
summary_en.method: The alloy composition was altered and SLM parameters were optimized to reduce cracking and improve densification.

summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and density measurements confirmed the improved processability.

papers.title: Regulation of Chondrogenesis and Hypertrophy in Silk Fibroin-Gelatin-Based 3D Bioprinted Constructs
papers.abstract: To date, the development of phenotypically stable, functionally equivalent engineered cartilage tissue constructs remains elusive. This study explored chondrogenic differentiation and suppression of hypertrophic differentiation in tyrosinase cross-linked silk-gelatin bioink using different cell modalities (dispersed, aggregates) for chondrocytes and mesenchymal progenitor cells (hMSCs) compared against the "gold standard" hMSC spheroids. Chondrogenic differentiation of hMSC spheroids (without silk-gelatin) showed a constant increase in hypertrophy over 21 days (gradual upregulated expression of COL10A1, MMP13). On the contrary, hMSC-laden constructs (both dispersed and aggregates) in bioink showed upregulated hypoxia (HIF1A) which positively regulated the expression of chondrogenic markers (aggrecan, COMP1) over chondrocyte-laden constructs. The gelatin component in the bioink induced MMP2 activity, which degraded the synthesized matrix, creating a pericellular zone for the accumulation of growth factors and newly synthesized matrices. We believe that the combinatorial effect of these accumulated factors as well as the hypoxia-regulated HDAC4 pathway played a pivotal role in stabilizing the chondrogenic phenotype of differentiated hMSCs along with suppressed hypertrophy. Therefore, the results suggest that tyrosinase cross-linked silk-gelatin bioink offers a suitable material composition for 3D bioprinting of cartilage constructs. Further standardization is warranted to investigate the biological mechanisms minimizing hypertrophic differentiation of hMSC/chondrocytes toward development of improved cartilage constructs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究生物墨水的组成对软骨形成的影响，未涉及任何人工智能方法或自动化决策环节。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a biological study of bioink composition on chondrogenesis without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发表型稳定的软骨组织工程构建物。
summary_zh.method: 使用酪氨酸酶交联的丝素-明胶生物墨水打印含不同细胞形式的软骨构建物。
summary_zh.result: 该生物墨水通过低氧调控通路稳定hMSC的软骨表型并抑制肥大分化。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证基因表达和组织学特征。

summary_en.motivation: To develop phenotypically stable cartilage constructs by investigating the role of bioink composition in regulating chondrogenesis and hypertrophy.
summary_en.method: Tyrosinase-crosslinked silk fibroin-gelatin bioink was used to 3D bioprint constructs with dispersed or aggregated chondrocytes and hMSCs, compared to hMSC spheroids.
summary_en.result: The silk-gelatin bioink upregulated hypoxia markers and suppressed hypertrophic differentiation through the HDAC4 pathway, stabilizing the chondrogenic phenotype.
summary_en.validation: In vitro gene expression analysis, histological staining, and comparison with control spheroids validated the findings.
